text:
incident-bot: SEV2 ALERT — gpu-pool-saturation detected in eu-west-1 (pool: euw-gpu-7). queue_length spike > 95th percentile for 3m. autoscaler attempts=5, failures=3. possible cause: recent model rollout v30.4. tags: #gpu #autoscale #rollout

maya: seeing the same in dashboards. p95 latency on generation up ~2.8x, queue growth to ~12k. Paging oncall. I’m on it.

raj: i’m with you — logs show kvcache miss rate jumped dramatically after v30.4. prefill traffic looks amplified (more prefix tokens).

sophia: quick note: v30.4 enables expanded context prefill for few models (config change). it increases KV warmup footprint per request. that could explain memory pressure -> lower parallelism -> queueing.

oliver: Support: customers in EU experiencing 503s on text-generation endpoints since ~4942005600. reported by 3 enterprise customers (acct ids masked). CS alerted.

maya: immediate plan: 1) stop rollout (freeze) 2) scale up pool if possible 3) apply rate cap on v30.4 traffic 4) on-call handoff to runtime (raj) for hotfix. can anyone confirm freeze command?

deploy-bot: deploy-status: rollout v30.4 pause command acknowledged by controller. active rollout halted across eu-west-1 and global canary.

raj: i’m taking handoff. first mitigation: pin production routes to v30.3 for high-traffic customers and route v30.4 to a quarantine pool. doing a targeted reroute for top 5 tenants.

sophia: i’ll patch model config to disable expanded prefill behavior as a short-term config revert. patch will be non-breaking and only affects new activations.

maya: if you need me to approve extra GPUs, say now. current autoscaler is hitting max_pools per zone — looks like we exhausted soft limits.

raj: request: spin up 4x temporary g4dn nodes in euw-gpu-7, but that will take ~7–9 min. meanwhile I’ll throttle inflight requests to v30.4 to limit prefill fanout.

oliver: CS: advising affected customers with ETA ~15–20m for partial relief. offering retry guidance and status updates.

maya: apply throttle command:

```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/reroute -H 'Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]' -d '{"route":"/gen","from_model":"v30.4","to_model":"v30.3","tenants":["acct-AAA","acct-BBB","acct-CCC","acct-DDD","acct-EEE"]}'
```

raj: reroute executed for top5 tenants — responses show 200 on control plane. starting throttles on other tenants at 30% of previous concurrency.

sophia: patched model config to disable expanded prefill: commit 6f3a21c applied to runtime config; pushing to quarantine pool now.

incident-bot: autoscaler events: attempt 6 -> max_capacity_reached for euw-gpu-7; pending queue=9,400; throttling activated on pool (policy: soft_throttle).

maya: monitoring: queue length trending down slowly after reroutes and throttles. p95 latency still elevated but improving. can we get a KV cache warmup snapshot?

raj: snapshot (excerpt):

```
KVCacheStats {
  total_keys: 12,432,001
  active_keys_recent: 1,234,567
  miss_rate_90m: 0.47 -> pre-rollout 0.18
  avg_kv_size_bytes: 2048 -> increased by 1.9x
}
```

raj: miss rate and avg_kv_size both increased — suggests per-request context expanded and fewer prefix hits. that explains throughput regression.

oliver: CS update: affected customers seeing partial recovery; two still on degraded performance. logged incident IDs for both and offered credits.

carla: product: was the expanded prefill flagged as opt-in? why did it roll out automatically to prod? want root cause thread after stabilizing.

sophia: it was intended as opt-in for canary, but rollout rule mistakenly had the canary flag unset for the eu region — rollout controller bug. creating PR to revert canary flag to safe default.

maya: next steps: 1) keep v30.3 pinned for high-traffic customers 2) scale temporary nodes until autoscaler recovers 3) schedule rollback of v30.4 if config revert doesn't fully mitigate 4) full RCA channel later. any objections?

raj: i’ll leave a temporary override on autoscaler to allow +6 nodes in euw for 1h. will monitor queue and cancel if not helpful.

incident-bot: autoscaler override applied by maya. added policy: emergency_scale_limit=+6 for euw-gpu-7 (expires 1h).

maya: handing off oncall to raj for ongoing mitigation. I’ll remain reachable for approvals. @raj — you’re oncall.

raj: oncall acknowledged. monitoring dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/euw-gpu-7 (share privileges set).

oliver: support will send another customer update in 10m with current mitigation and ETA.

sophia: rolling back canary flag change PR now. plan to ship a hotpatch to prevent accidental global canary disables.

raj: queue down to ~3.6k, p95 latency down 1.6x from peak. with override nodes +2 already active and rebooting.

maya: good progress. once stable for 20m, we can de-escalate and move to postmortem. please capture timeline + config diffs.

carla: noted. product will coordinate customer comms and add to status page. want targeted postmortem with action items: release gating, rollout checks, autoscaler safety caps.

raj: logging action items here: 1) enforce canary flag checks in rollout controller 2) add model-config preflight check for estimated KV footprint 3) autoscaler to surface 'prefill-driven' signals 4) run load tests for v30.x variants on staging with p95 context sizes.

incident-bot: STATUS CHANGE: incident state -> mitigation. impact: reduced from widespread to limited. next update planned in 15m.

oliver: final customer note drafted, will send after next validation.

maya: handing back to normal ops after 30m stable window. if anything regresses, reopen paging and ping this thread. great job team :thumbsup:
